🌿 Growing Green Together: Pubali Bank PLC & South Apollo Medical College & Hospital Launch Tree Plantation & Knowledge Sharing Event!

In a joint commitment toward environmental sustainability and fostering strong institutional collaboration, Pubali Bank PLC, in association with South Apollo Medical College & Hospital Pvt. Ltd., proudly inaugurated a Tree Plantation Program, followed by an insightful Exchange of Views session.

The event focused on promoting green initiatives, combatting climate change, and discussing future avenues of mutual partnership for community welfare.

🌱 Distinguished Guests & Leadership in Attendance:
Chief Guest: Mr. Mohammad Ali (Managing Director & CEO, Pubali Bank PLC)
Presiding Chair: Prof. Dr. Md. Zahurul Haq, Chairman, South Apollo Medical College, Bsl.

Special Guests:
Prof. Dr. Md. Faizul Bashar, Principal, SAMC, Bsl.
Prof. Dr. S.M. Sarwar, Director, SAMCH, Bsl.
Dr. Md. Abdul Hamid Shaikh, MD, SAMC&H, Bsl.
Mr. Muhammed Moshahidullah, Pubali Bank PLC.

During the event, tree saplings were planted across the campus grounds to mark the beginning of a greener tomorrow. The subsequent "Exchange of Views" session provided a fruitful platform for honorable guests and management to share valuable perspectives on corporate social responsibility (CSR) and sustainable institutional practices.

Together, we remain dedicated to nurturing our environment and building stronger bridges for the betterment of society! 🌍💚
